HES FinTech.evidence: HES FinTech is an active financial software vendor founded in 2012 and headquartered in Vilnius, Lithuania, under the legal name UAB HES Europe. The company explicitly offers a trade finance software platform on its official website (hesfintech.com).

VenaChain Technologies.evidence: Vena Chain is a portfolio company of Velex Investments (which operates from Dubai and Nairobi) providing next-generation digital supply chain, trade finance, and banking platforms. This information is sourced from the official portfolios of Velex Investments and venachain.com.
